Complexity.description: Task Profiler's assessment of task complexity.
Complexity.title: Complexity

description:
Output of the Task Profiler.

Task complexity analysis lives here, not in LayaClassification.
This model describes what the task needs and how complex it is.
It does not contain execution steps, tool calls, graph nodes,
graph edges, agent decisions, or runtime state.

intent_id.description: Links back to the originating Intent.
intent_id.title: Intent Id

task_type.description: High-level task structure (e.g., single-step, multi-step, exploratory).

requirements.description: What the task needs (tools, data, etc.).
requirements.title: Requirements

estimated_steps.description: Informational hint only. The Planner determines the actual step count.
estimated_steps.title: Estimated Steps

prerequisites.description: Conditions that must be met before execution.
prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
